newsitem.title: UK: Rank pushes up ahead of trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Rank pushes up ahead of trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Rank Group Plc were up 10-1/2p at 438 by 1040 GMT as the market anticipated an upbeat trading statement from the leisure group later this week, dealers and analysts said.
"The volume isn't great but we've seen some buying. People are hoping Rank will have some good things to say about the coming year," one market maker said.

Rank chief executive Andrew Teare may also announce during his presentation on Thursday that the company intends to move its Hard Rock Cafe chain into the music business through a joint venture with Time Warner, analysts said.
"Rank wants to enhance the Hard Rock brandname wherever possible. Music is the first step in that direction," said Brian Newman, leisure analyst at Henderson Crosthwaite.
"We are buyers of Rank -- the shares are oversold. We think they will issue a confident trading statement on Thursday."
